title: They leak!
text: They leak!. [[VIDEOID:eaae20aeebf1ddb5400d80663e541171]] I bought these in February 2021… I had plans with girlfriends to get together and do freezer meal prep. We never got together as one of the friends moved… But I just opened the bags last week to freeze chicken and dumplings. I was so excited to use them finally. When I took it out of the fridge today after leaving it in there to thaw I noticed a lot of leaking. I thought it was the moisture from having been frozen. But the bag has two major leaks. I’m hoping my other bags do not leak but now I feel like I need to check them all and I wish I would’ve checked them when I first got them to make sure they were OK because now I cannot return them.
